activities.name: The Bund (Waitan) — waterfront promenade
activities.hours: Open air, 24 hours (public waterfront). Best at dusk/night for Pudong skyline lights.
activities.exceptions: Crowded during CNY/Lantern Festival and weekends. Ferry to Pudong available (verify schedule).
activities.transit_from_bund_base: 0 min (you are here) — Huangpu hotels walkable
activities.verification: Free public space — no ticket/hours to verify. Ferry schedule: Unverified — needs review.

activities.notes: Anchor activity for every Huangpu base. Pair with Canton 8 / Imperial Treasure / Mr & Mrs Bund.

activities.name: Shanghai Museum (People's Square)
activities.hours: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 (last entry 15:00). Closed Mondays (except national holidays). Evening sessions (09:00–21:00) on select days — check official WeChat.
activities.exceptions: Book via official WeChat Mini Program (overseas via Trip.com). Bring original ID. Capacity limits apply. Special exhibition 'On Top of the World Tree' runs 2026-07-09 to 2027-11-14 (People's Square hosts no other exhibitions during this period per museum).
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~10–15 min by metro (East Nanjing Rd → People's Square, Line 2) or walk ~20 min
activities.verification: Verified — official museum page (hours, booking, exhibition dates).
activities.notes: Bronze, ceramics, calligraphy. Allow 2–3 hours. Go at 09:00 opening on a weekday.

activities.name: Yu Garden (Yuyuan) — classical garden
activities.cost_for_two_cny: ¥80 (2 × ¥40 adult, peak season Apr–Jun / Sep–Nov; Feb is low season — confirm price)
activities.hours: 09:00–16:30 (last entry 16:00). Closed Mondays (except national holidays). CNY hours by separate notice.
activities.exceptions: ⚠️ Secondary sources listing 08:30–17:00 are outdated — use official 09:00–16:30. Garden ≠ surrounding bazaar (bazaar is free, open district).
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~10 min walk from Bund south end; metro Yuyuan Garden (Lines 10/14)
activities.notes: 460-year-old Ming garden. 1–2 hours inside + bazaar outside. Arrive at 09:00 to beat crowds.

activities.name: Shanghai Tower — observation deck (118F)
activities.hours: ⚠️ CONFLICTING: 08:30–22:00 (last entry 21:30) vs 10:00–21:00. Treat as Unverified — confirm on shanghaitower.com before visiting.
activities.exceptions: Passport/ID required. Book timed slot online. Haze can ruin views — check forecast; winter mornings after rain are clearest.
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~15–20 min by metro (East Nanjing Rd → Lujiazui, Line 2) + walk
activities.verification: Ticket ¥180: secondary consensus. Hours: Unverified — needs review (official site check required).
activities.notes: China's tallest building (632 m). 1–1.5 hours. Best 60–90 min before sunset.

activities.name: Shanghai Natural History Museum
activities.cost_for_two_cny: ¥60 (2 × ¥30 adult; students ¥12, seniors 60–69 ¥25; under-6/under-1.3m free with reservation)
activities.hours: Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00 (last entry 16:00). Closed Mondays (except public holidays). Saturdays sometimes extended to 20:00 — verify.
activities.exceptions: No on-site ticketing — book via official WeChat account/mini-program. Real-name reservation required. Popular theaters sell out fast.
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~20–25 min by metro (East Nanjing Rd → Natural History Museum, Line 13 via transfer)
activities.verification: Hours/ticket: secondary consensus (Trip.com + guides). Official site link provided — confirm before booking. Flagged for official re-check.
activities.notes: Dinosaur skeletons + immersive theaters. Metro Line 13, Exit 1.

activities.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
activities.cost_for_two_cny: ¥320 (2 × ¥160 adult; children 1–1.4 m ¥110; under 1 m free)
activities.hours: Daily 09:00–18:00 (last entry 17:30). Weekends/holidays sometimes to 20:00–21:00 — verify. (Secondary sources; confirm on official site.)
activities.exceptions: Arrive early on weekends/holidays. Advance booking saves ~¥5/person per one source (verify).
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~20 min by metro (East Nanjing Rd → Lujiazui, Line 2)
activities.verification: Hours/ticket: secondary consensus — Unverified on official site in this pass. Needs review.

activities.name: Xintiandi — heritage shopping/dining district
activities.hours: Open district (shops/restaurants have individual hours — verify per venue). T'ang Court (Langham) is here.
activities.exceptions: Crowded evenings/weekends. Lantern Festival decorations expected (verify 2027 program).
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~15 min by metro (East Nanjing Rd → Xintiandi, Line 10/12) or taxi ~10 min
activities.verification: District is public/open — no single hours. Venue hours: verify individually. Flagged for review.
activities.notes: Shikumen stone-gate houses + modern retail. Good evening pairing with T'ang Court dinner.

activities.name: French Concession — Wukang Road / Anfu Road walk
activities.hours: Open streets, 24 hours. Cafés/shops individual hours.
activities.exceptions: Best in morning light. Pair with Ji Pin Court (Xuhui) or Fu He Hui (Changning).
activities.transit_from_bund_base: ~20–30 min by metro (Line 10/12 to Shaanxi South Rd / French Concession area)
activities.verification: Public streets — no ticket/hours. Flagged for review (no official single source).
activities.notes: Plane-tree streets, heritage villas. Low-effort, high-charm day. Fu He Hui is on Yuyuan Road nearby.
